Team Dragon Rampage! |border color={{dragon color}} |background color={{dragon color light}} |lightened color={{dragon color}} }} '''Team Dragon Rampage''' (Japanese: '''ドラゴン爆走団''' ''Dragon Rampage Gang'') are recurring characters who first appeared in ''[[HZ096|Crash! Team Dragon Rampage!]]''. They are led by '''Neki''' (Japanese: '''ネキ''' ''Neki'') with members '''Dorara''' (Japanese: '''ドララ''' ''Dorara'') and '''Dora''' (Japanese: '''ドーラ''' ''Dora''). ==History== Team Dragon Rampage is a group of former {{tc|Dragon Tamer|Dragon Tamer clan}} members that protects and cares for {{type|Dragon}} Pokémon in the vicinity of [[Blackthorn City]]. One of their most recurring enemies is [[Snake]] and the members of Team Wriggle (Japanese: クネクネ団だん ''Kunekune-dan'', literally Wriggling Gang). [[HZ089|About a year ago]], an injured [[Black Rayquaza]] appeared at the [[Dragon's Den]], a temple dedicated to restoring Pokémon's energy, and has been recovering ever since. To avoid attracting the attention of curious onlookers, the Dragon Rampage Clan has been spreading various rumors and clues to draw attention away from the Black Rayquaza. In ''[[HZ096|Crash! Team Dragon Rampage!]]'', they met [[Liko]], [[Roy]], and [[Ult]] and, thinking they were just curious, tried to change the subject. After battling Roy and Ult and knocking down the latter's {{p|Sableye}}, they decided to leave. Some time later, they saw the trio defeat Snake, and upon realizing Liko and Roy's good intentions, they decided to take the group to the Black Rayquaza. During the reunion, Neki and her friends explained what had happened since then. As they said goodbye to Liko, Roy, and Ult, they promised that they would take care of Rayquaza until it was ready to fly again. In [[HZ129]], the group reunited with the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] and discovered that Ult owned a {{p|Dragonite}}. They revealed some information about {{OBP|Salt|Horizons}}, Ult's father, and took Roy and the others to meet Black Rayquaza. When the [[Legendary Pokémon]] regained its strength, they watched Roy and Ult battle it.
